description: Calculate guitar or bass string tension in pounds, kilograms and Newtons. See list_bundles for related 'musique' calculators.

frequency_hz.description: Target tuning frequency in Hz (e.g. 329.63 for E4)

gauge_inches.description: String gauge in inches (e.g. 0.010 for a light gauge high E)

scale_length_inches.description: Instrument scale length in inches (e.g. 25.5 for Fender Stratocaster)

name: calculate_string_tension

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate String Tension
